items.title: Micron Stock Is Leading a Brutal New Chip Slump
items.summary: Micron  stock was among the sharpest fallers Tuesday after being spared the worst of the selling in the previous session.  Micron stock was down 9% by midafternoon, while  Sandisk Western Digital  and  Advanced Micro Devices  were down around 15%, 8.2%, and 7.9%, respectively.  The Nasdaq Composite was mostly flat despite the chaos.
